objective: Replace M141r3 early-PWP and already-sparse-mask assumptions with a raw 128-bit row boundary, explicit zero-row cost, complete-bank materialization, and bounded two-engine ownership, tied to synthesis-acyclic M142 RTL.

architecture_contract.raw_input: one row contains eight unfiltered 16-bit signed source masks; all-zero rows are legal and counted
architecture_contract.descriptorizer: one canonical block-major K1..K4 descriptor per cycle
architecture_contract.engines: independent single PWP and single correction ready/valid endpoints
architecture_contract.release: only matching correction completion frees a bank

selection.reason: B4 retains 2.5947x versus compact256 and 1.8122x versus dualrow512 in the stricter model, but external SRAM capacity and energy are not priced.

paper_safe_statement: On the frozen heldout module recurrence, raw-128 ingress plus complete-bank materialization gives B4 135,461,009 cycles, 2.5947x versus compact256 serial and 1.8122x versus dualrow512 serial at the same assumed clock. This is not RTL throughput, matched-frequency, physical, full-network, or system speedup.
prohibited_claims: Do not cite the superseded M141r3 2.6362x without its early-PWP qualification.
Do not call 2.5947x measured RTL or physical speedup.
Do not call 1.8122x full-network or end-to-end speedup.
Do not call 8.2301x a system result; fixed8 is a same-clock service-island baseline.
Do not treat the fourth external descriptor/result bank as free area or energy.
